name: query_nearby_resources
description: Ask the system what dispatch resources are nearby. Use this when the caller asks about response time. Honestly report what the response says — never invent ETAs.

request_body_schema.description: Geographic query for nearby dispatch units.

lat.description: Latitude of the caller (or incident location).

lng.description: Longitude of the caller (or incident location).

radiusKm.description: Search radius in kilometers. Default 5 if omitted.
